entities.title: Example tests
entities.summary: The two example suites (utvfirst/ and nativefirst/) and the shared fixture they use.
entities.purpose: Holds Fixtures, the shared test data every UTV zone example loads (Fixtures.demoZoneRules reads conformance/rules/demo-zones.json in place), and its own test. The examples themselves are in utvfirst/ and nativefirst/, one suite each.
boundaries: The repository has no example programs: every example is a unit test (AGENTS.md section 2).
nativefirst/ holds only time/ and has no .dev of its own.
Tests mirror production (AGENTS.md 1.9): each test class is named after the class it exercises, and verification.json names it.
